text: Congrats! You won the lottery! You get to choose between two prizes: one million dollars right now, or a penny that doubles each day for thirty days. Which one would you choose? After thirty days, one million dollars is, well, one million dollars. On the other hand, a penny that doubled every day for thirty days becomes over five point three million dollars. This is because of compound interest. Compound interest is a superpower that makes your money grow faster and faster over time. The earlier you start, the more compound interest can grow your money. For example, if you started doubling that penny just five days earlier, it would have become one hundred seventy two million dollars. Stocks can grow from compound interest, so starting with small amounts can become large over time. Bloom offers a tool that shows you how much money you can make by investing. Try it out.
